summary: ChronoScale Corp filed an 8-K disclosing entry into an unsecured Demand Grid Promissory Note with Applied Digital Corporation, which provides a $100M line of credit for working capital. No advances have been made. The lender and its affiliate hold ~96% of ChronoScale's common stock, and shared directors include Wes Cummins, Ella Benson, Douglas Miller, and Richard Nottenburg. The note carries interest at the short-term Applicable Federal Rate, is not convertible, and allows prepayment without penalty. The transaction was approved by related party committees. This is a routine credit facility, not a special situation event.
